'''Gerrit E. W. Bauer''' is a physicist and Professor and Principal Investigator at [[Tohoku University]]. He is one of the top highly-cited researchers (h>100) according to [[webometrics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Highly Cited Researchers (h>100) according to their Google Scholar Citations public profiles {{!}} Ranking Web of Universities: Webometrics ranks 30000 institutions |url=https://www.webometrics.info/en/hlargerthan100 |website=www.webometrics.info}}</ref>
